messages:
Zara: Weird one 0min ago I spotted a stack of unclaimed packages by Hotdesk 2 labeled 'PERSONAL' and one small cake box with 'Do not tilt' on it. Anyone know who that belongs to?
Front Desk Bot: @channel Mailroom notice: unclaimed personal parcels are routed to the mailroom inbox after 2 business days. If you need immediate pickup, file a pickup request: https://redwood-internal/mailroom/pickup.
Ken: That might be mine?? I got an order notification but it showed 'delivered to front desk' yesterday. I was remote. Can someone check the package IDs?
Mailroom: Hi Ken  we logged packages this morning: PKG-8892 (Ken), PKG-8893 (unlabeled), PKG-8894 (catering ), CAKE-01 (no name). CAKE-01 is fragile and marked 'Do not tilt'.
Priya: CAKE-01 was probably from my sister (birthday surprise). I forgot to add my name on the order. Can you hold it behind the desk? Im in at 2pm.
Janine: Quick badge note  if folks expect guests and want them to self-checkin, the lobby kiosk is down today for an update. Front desk will need to prereg visitors manually until 4pm. Sorry for the inconvenience.
Zara: Oof good catch. Also, can we get a sign on Hotdesk 2 so people don't assume the pile is free office snacks? :sweat_smile:
Front Desk Bot: Temporary sign requested: "Please do not move packages. Front Desk holds parcels." Placed at Hotdesk 2.
Ken: Thanks Mailroom. Ill swing by at 11 to pick PKG-8892. If CAKE-01 is perishable, please keep it on a flat surface; no fridge needed per vendor note.
Mailroom: Noted. CAKE-01 vendor note: keep upright, avoid stacking.
Priya: Thanks everyone. Janine  any ETA on kiosk coming back? We have a contractor coming at 3pm and would prefer they self-checkin.
Janine: The kiosk update is expected to finish by 4pm but could be earlier. If contractor arrives before kiosk is live, please prereg via this form and print a temporary badge: https://redwood-internal/checkin/manual.
Zara: One more small ask  can front desk hold personal packages for 5 business days instead of 3 when people explicitly request it? My plants delivery got delayed last month.
Front Desk Bot: Policy note: default hold = 3 business days. Extended holds can be requested case-by-case by DMing Mailroom. We'll accommodate when space allows.
Ken: Appreciate it. Ill label mine when I pick it up. CAKE-01  please don't give to anyone else until Priya confirms.
Priya: Confirmed  its mine. Ill be there at 2.
Zara: Thanks team. If Janine or Mailroom want me to move the temporary sign after kiosk is back up, I can do that. :thumbsup:
